blocks.tex: The four-vertex window is a value-separated alternating pattern in a cyclic curvature word. The constant-profile realization and the retained elementary reductions supply the base cases.

blocks.label: def:discrete_fourvertex
blocks.title: discrete four-vertex window
blocks.body:
For $c \in \mathbb{R}$, the profile $\kappa : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies
  $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ when there exist four cyclically ordered indices —
  represented by $\mathbb{N}$-lifts $i_1 < i_2 < i_3 < i_4 < i_1 + n$ — with
  \[
    \kappa_{i_2},\ \kappa_{i_4} \;<\; c \;<\; \kappa_{i_1},\ \kappa_{i_3}.
  \]
  (Two ``high'' values separated by two ``low'' values, alternating across the
  window level $c$.)

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV
lean.code:
def DFV (κ : ZMod n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ i₁ i₂ i₃ i₄ : ℕ, i₁ < i₂ ∧ i₂ < i₃ ∧ i₃ < i₄ ∧ i₄ < i₁ + n ∧
    c < κ ((i₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c ∧
    c < κ ((i₃ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ∧ κ ((i₄ : ℕ) : ZMod n) < c

blocks.label: def:discrete_fourvertex_pos
blocks.title: positive discrete four-vertex hypothesis
blocks.body:
$\mathrm{DiscreteFourVertexPos}\,\kappa$ holds when $\kappa_i > 0$ for all $i$
  and either $\kappa$ is constant or $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ holds for some
  $c > 0$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DiscreteFourVertexPos

blocks.label: cor:dfv_plateau_extrema_window
blocks.title: the DFV window meets Dahlberg's conclusion class --- wrapped form
blocks.body:
If $\mathrm{DFV}(\kappa; c)$ then $\kappa$ has two disjoint plateau maximum
  runs and two disjoint plateau minimum runs (the conclusion of
  \cref{thm:dfv_plateau_bridge}).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.DFV.plateau_extrema
lean.code:
theorem DFV.plateau_extrema {κ : ZMod n → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (h : DFV κ c) :
    (∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
        PlateauMaxRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMaxRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
        ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
          ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) ∧
    (∃ a₁ k₁ a₂ k₂ : ℕ, k₁ < n ∧ k₂ < n ∧
        PlateauMinRun κ a₁ k₁ ∧ PlateauMinRun κ a₂ k₂ ∧
        ∀ m₁, m₁ ≤ k₁ → ∀ m₂, m₂ ≤ k₂ →
          ((a₁ + m₁ : ℕ) : ZMod n) ≠ ((a₂ + m₂ : ℕ) : ZMod n)) := by
  obtain ⟨i₁, i₂, i₃, i₄, h12, h23, h34, h41, hκ1, hκ2, hκ3, hκ4⟩ := h
  exact dfv_plateau_extrema h12 h23 h34 h41 hκ1 hκ2 hκ3 hκ4

deps.title: the DFV window yields Dahlberg's conclusion class
deps.label: thm:dfv_plateau_bridge

blocks.tex:
Unfold \cref{def:discrete_fourvertex} to the explicit lifted window
  $i_1 < i_2 < i_3 < i_4 < i_1 + n$ with the four level inequalities ---
  exactly the hypothesis shape of the landed
  \cref{thm:dfv_plateau_bridge} (\texttt{dfv\_plateau\_extrema} takes the
  window unfolded because \texttt{DFV} did not yet exist in-tree when it
  landed @086). A one-line \texttt{obtain}-and-apply; no re-proof.
